question: What do RERA and DLD actually regulate?
answer: The Dubai Land Department (DLD) is the government body that registers property ownership, oversees title transfers and maintains the property register. The Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA) operates under the DLD and regulates the real estate sector itself — licensing brokerages and agents, registering tenancy contracts (Ejari), maintaining the Rental Index, and protecting off-plan buyers through project escrow accounts. Nova Casa Real Estate is a RERA-registered agency (License No. 49747).
